hooks.command: python3 -I -B -c "import hashlib, os, runpy, sys, tempfile;from pathlib import Path;package_root = Path(sys.argv[1]);package_digest = sys.argv[2];configured_snapshots = os.environ.get('TJ_AGENTS_STARTUP_SNAPSHOT_DIRECTORY', '');plugin_data = Path(os.environ.get('PLUGIN_DATA', '')).resolve();snapshots = Path(configured_snapshots) if configured_snapshots else plugin_data / 'hook-snapshots';snapshot_key = hashlib.sha256((str(package_root) + chr(0) + package_digest).encode()).hexdigest();loader = snapshots / snapshot_key / 'hooks' / 'codex' / 'snapshot.py';loader = loader if loader.is_file() else package_root / 'hooks' / 'codex' / 'snapshot.py';newline = chr(10).encode();source = loader.read_bytes().replace(chr(13).encode() + newline, newline).replace(chr(13).encode(), newline) if loader.is_file() else b'';hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() == '0ed79f8035546d9ba2ff07b1d2f0bf0fd7fe7bdf7805510942ffeb45baee4148' or (sys.stderr.write('Codex hook snapshot loader integrity check failed' + chr(10)), sys.exit(2));workspace = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory();staged = Path(workspace.name) / 'loader.py';staged.write_bytes(source);runpy.run_path(str(staged), run_name='__main__')" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" "sha256:f1b72c934073a6c86ed4ef30b8da92eab10535e3d89db033be35816bf520721f" "agent" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook_dispatch.py" --deadline 7 --hook "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/.agents/agent/utility/peer/scripts/register_session.py" --hook "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/.agents/agent/runtime/reap_orphans.py" --notice
